---
title: "Dimensionality reduction"
---

Steps that consume many columns at once and emit a few informative ones (the
grouping follows [Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)). In the
[eight-position ordering](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd) these are
[Multivariate transforms](../four-stages/multivariate-transforms.qmd), the
whole of stage 4: they run last, on the finished, scaled matrix.

Three steps to know:

- `StepPca`: project numeric columns onto principal components.
- `StepClassDistance`: replace numeric columns with each sample's distance to
  every class centroid; one of the few steps that uses the target.
- Partial least squares, a supervised projection that picks components for
  predicting the target: planned, see
  [#213](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/issues/213).

*Stub: content to come.*
